ModMetaData.name: Crashed Ship Mechanoid Guard Fix [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Fix a case where defoliator and psychic ships arrive without mechanoid guards FEATURES The fix checks that a group has at least one affordable mechanoid before the game chooses it. Other eligible vanilla groups keep their usual selection weights Only the two vanilla ship-part incidents are affected. Noncombat groups stay unchanged Threat points, pawn costs and the individual cost limit are unchanged. The fix does not create a fallback squad or change ships that have already crashed COMPATIBILITY RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077). Load this mod after Harmony. No DLC is required Can be added to or removed from an existing save FEEDBACK Found a bug?
